title: The isoperimetric profile of the cubic three-torus

result.label: The isoperimetric profile of the cubic three-torus
result.statement: Determines the isoperimetric profile of the unit cubic flat three-torus and classifies every finite-perimeter minimizer: balls, circular tubes around shortest closed geodesics, coordinate slabs, and their complements. The transition volumes are 4 /81 and 1/ , with exactly the adjacent two types minimizing at each transition.
